pages.title: Glowstone Singularity
pages.text: Glowstone dust compacted into one point, glowing so brightly it is hard to look at directly. It is warm and seems to light everything near it. Its light flickers slightly, as if keeping time. Shadows do not quite form behind it, as if the light wraps round.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Glowstone gives off light without burning, so I wondered what happened if it was compressed. The Singularity Compactor crushed it into a point that shone far brighter than the original dust.
